correctness.rationale: The basis-pair Rota-Baxter defect is reconstructed explicitly and gives the complete polynomial system. When 2 is invertible the system is exactly b=0 and a(a-2d)=0, yielding two planes with a one-line intersection. The automorphism group follows from preservation of the characteristic square ideal and the relation e1^2=2e2; its conjugation formulas give the exact odd-field orbit census. In characteristic two the multiplication is identically zero, so every endomorphism is Rota-Baxter. Exhaustive checks over F2, F3, F5, and F7 reproduce the counts, ranks, and orbit data.

value.rationale: J5 is one of the canonical two-dimensional Jordan isomorphism types used in the complete low-dimensional source classification. The result refines the raw complex parameter families into exact finite-field rank and automorphism-moduli data, and it identifies the sharp characteristic-two degeneration where the entire four-dimensional endomorphism space becomes Rota-Baxter. The automorphism quotient is a natural moduli invariant and is not a routine recounting of the source table.
